# Fixtures

Generated by `cargo run -p cormex-transcript --example sample_fixtures`.

Anonymization rules: **anon@1**.

Every free-text value has been replaced with synthetic text of the same length and character class. Ids are mapped consistently, so `parentUuid ↔ uuid` and `tool_use_id ↔ tool_result` references still point at each other. Timestamps are shifted by one constant, preserving order and format.
